auth: Do not remove or bypass credential validation.
Do not reveal whether the email or username exists on failed authentication.
Reuse the existing token/session generation path.
Do not change the order of critical authentication steps unless explicitly requested.
payment: Do not mark payment as successful before gateway verification completes.
Do not bypass payment validation or fraud checks.
signup: Do not create duplicate user records.
Preserve password hashing and validation rules.
Reuse the existing account creation path when possible.
session: Do not create a second session model if one already exists.
Reuse the existing session lifecycle and expiry rules.
